pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions with relatively smooth edge gradients. Patches on the lower neck are larger and more elongated, while flank patches show increased geometric complexity with sharper vertices.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Wide, off-white negative space pathways forming a continuous topological grid. Intersection nodes are primarily tri-nodal, with pixel thickness remaining relatively uniform across the visible upper flank and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the neck and shoulder. The mane presents as a dark, dense fringe with visible fiber-like texture against the background foliage.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant foreground occlusion by green deciduous foliage obscuring the lower ventral region and limbs.
